expected_behavior: Each screen has one primary action, and it is the only action that uses size, weight and colour all at once; headings are not counted.
Text and forms are left-aligned on one edge; body text is never centred or justified.
Colour comes last: near-black text on near-white, one grey for secondary text, never pure black on pure white.
A single accent colour marks only what the user can act on — the primary button, links, focus ring, active state.
A screen is done only when it passes the pre-flight checklist.
source: Principle 2 — Group by space, not chrome
Principle 3 — Design in grayscale, add color last
